featured.title: Four Days of Relief — The $100,000 H-1B Fee Returns While the First Circuit Decides
featured.excerpt: Judge Sorokin struck down the fee on June 8 as an unauthorized tax. Four days later, he agreed to pause his own ruling while the government appeals.
featured.image_caption: The John Joseph Moakley United States Courthouse in Boston, where Judge Sorokin issued and then stayed his ruling
featured.nri_angle: Indians account for over 70% of H-1B approvals; the $100K fee has already crashed registrations by 27%, and its reinstatement means new petitions face the charge while three courts sort out whether it is legal.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Indian Banks Are Offering NRI Dollar Deposits at Rates Not Seen in a Decade. The RBI Is Picking Up the Tab.
news.excerpt: SBI, HDFC, ICICI, and Kotak have all hiked FCNR(B) rates to as high as 7.1 per cent after the central bank agreed to absorb the full hedging cost. Analysts say $60–70 billion could flow in by September.
news.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India building in Kolkata
news.nri_angle: NRIs can now earn up to 7.1% on dollar deposits in Indian banks — the highest in a decade — with zero currency hedging risk, as the RBI absorbs the cost until September 2026.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Has Rejected Washington's 'Forced Labour' and 'Surplus Capacity' Charges. The 12.5 Per Cent Tariff Threat Is Now Part of the Deal.
news.excerpt: As USTR Jamieson Greer prepares to fly to India the week after the G7, New Delhi is pushing for an assurance that no new tariffs will follow the bilateral trade agreement. Both sides say mid-July is possible.
news.image_caption: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, who will visit India after the G7 summit
news.nri_angle: A US-India trade deal — the first in 75 years — could push bilateral trade toward $500 billion and directly affect millions of Indian Americans and Indian businesses operating across both economies.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Three Indian Sailors Are Dead After U.S. Navy Strikes. Delhi Has Summoned the American Envoy Twice.
news.excerpt: The Settebello strike killed three merchant mariners from UP, Himachal and Andhra. India is furious. Washington says comply or face consequences.
news.image_caption: U.S. Navy ships operating in the Gulf of Oman, where three Indian-crewed tankers were struck this week
news.nri_angle: Indian seafarers, overwhelmingly from middle-class families across UP, Kerala, Maharashtra and AP, are the sole earners sending remittances home — any sustained threat to maritime safety directly impacts household economies across the diaspora.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Jaishankar Says the U.S. Asked India to Buy Russian Oil. Then It Imposed Tariffs.
news.excerpt: At Finland’s Kultaranta Talks, India’s foreign minister laid out the receipts: Washington needed Indian refiners to stabilise crude markets in 2022. Now it is taxing them.
news.image_caption: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar at an official event
news.nri_angle: A breakdown in India-U.S. trade talks could ripple through H-1B processing goodwill, tariff exemptions on Indian goods, and the diplomatic climate NRI professionals depend on for business and immigration stability.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: A Judge Killed Trump's $100,000 H-1B Fee. Four Days Later, He Put His Own Ruling on Hold.
news.excerpt: The legal seesaw over the most disruptive visa fee in decades is far from over — and Congress is now moving to make it permanent.
news.image_caption: The United States Capitol in Washington, D.C.
news.nri_angle: Indians hold over 70% of H-1B visas — the legal battle over the $100,000 fee directly determines whether the next generation of Indian professionals can work in America.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: TCS Just Handed 50,000 Employees an AI Co-Worker. India's IT Industry Is Bracing for What Comes Next.
news.excerpt: The Anthropic deal is the biggest enterprise AI deployment by an Indian company — and the clearest signal yet that the $315 billion IT services model is being rebuilt from the inside.
news.image_caption: Artificial intelligence is reshaping India's IT services industry
news.nri_angle: Millions of NRI tech workers depend on India's IT services industry — the AI transformation underway at TCS directly affects their job security, career trajectory, and the value of their skills.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: America Has Also Run Out of EB-5 Investor Green Cards for Indians. The Queue Will Not Move Until October.
news.excerpt: A week after EB-2 visas hit their annual cap, the investor pathway has followed suit — leaving wealthy Indian applicants with no route to permanent residency until the new fiscal year begins.
news.image_caption: A United States permanent resident card — Indian EB-5 investor applicants will see no new green cards issued until the fiscal year resets in October (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: Indian investors who have committed hundreds of thousands of dollars to U.S. businesses now face months of limbo, with no EB-5 visas available until October — the second employment-based pathway to close on them in a week.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Want a U.S. Visa Interview in Ten Days? That Will Be $750, Please.
news.excerpt: The State Department will let B1/B2 visa applicants pay their way to the front of the queue starting July 1. For an Indian family of four, the total visa bill could top ₹3 lakh.
news.image_caption: The U.S. Embassy in New Delhi — the State Department's new premium appointment service will let visa applicants pay 50 for a guaranteed interview within ten business days (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: Indian families visiting relatives in America could face visa bills exceeding ₹3 lakh for a family of four under the new premium appointment scheme — adding financial strain to an already slow and uncertain process.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Belfast Is Burning. India's Cricket Tour of Ireland May Be the Next Casualty.
news.excerpt: Anti-immigration riots in Northern Ireland have put India's two-match T20I series in doubt. The BCCI is monitoring the situation, and a venue change is on the table.
news.nri_angle: Indians living in Belfast are anxious as anti-immigration riots grip the city — and the scheduled India cricket tour to Stormont could be relocated, depriving the local diaspora of a rare opportunity to watch the national team play.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India and the U.S. Just Signed a Ten-Year Defence Framework. It Covers Everything From Javelins to Jets.
news.excerpt: Rajnath Singh and Pete Hegseth formalised the agreement on the sidelines of ADMM-Plus in Kuala Lumpur, calling it the beginning of a 'new chapter' in bilateral defence ties.
news.image_caption: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh at an official engagement in New Delhi
news.nri_angle: A deeper India-U.S. defence relationship affects everything from visa climate to bilateral trade for the 4.4 million Indian-Americans in the United States.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: An Indian Staffing CEO Forged H-1B Petitions for Years. Now the DOJ Is Revoking His Citizenship.
news.excerpt: Neeraj Sharma of New Jersey is one of 17 naturalized citizens targeted in the largest denaturalization sweep in American history. USCIS has been asked to supply 100 to 200 cases per month.
news.image_caption: The Robert F. Kennedy Department of Justice Building in Washington, D.C.
news.nri_angle: With 100-200 denaturalization cases being referred monthly, naturalized Indian-Americans face a new era of scrutiny where past immigration applications are never truly closed.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: SpaceX's $75 Billion IPO Makes Musk the First Trillionaire. Indian Investors Are Scrambling to Get In.
news.excerpt: Indian investment platforms report 'unprecedented' traffic as retail investors chase the world's largest stock offering through LRS and US-listed intermediaries.
news.image_caption: SpaceX's Starbase facility in Boca Chica, Texas, headquarters of the newly public company
news.nri_angle: Indian investors can access SpaceX through LRS-compliant platforms, with FY26 foreign equity remittances already up 56 per cent — this listing accelerates a structural shift in cross-border capital flows from India.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Indian Markets Post Best Day in Two Months. Oil Crashed. The Rupee Rallied. Foreign Money May Follow.
news.excerpt: Sensex surged 1,695 points and the rupee hit 95.11 as Brent crude fell below $87 on hopes of a US-Iran peace deal. Analysts say the record $30 billion in foreign outflows may finally reverse.
news.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street, Mumbai
news.nri_angle: NRI investors who pulled back during the oil shock may find a peace deal, falling crude, and a strengthening rupee create a fundamentally different risk-reward equation for Indian equities.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: A Student Posted His Answer Sheet Online. It Wasn't His Handwriting. India's Largest Exam Board Is Now in Crisis.
news.excerpt: CBSE's on-screen marking system swapped answer sheets, exposed student data through security flaws, and survived coordinated cyber attacks — all within weeks of launch. Parliament has stepped in.
news.nri_angle: Hundreds of thousands of NRI families rely on CBSE board results as a foundational credential — the scandal undermines trust in the system that evaluates over 40 lakh students annually.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India's Inflation Just Hit Its Highest Level of 2026. Food and Fuel Are Doing the Damage.
news.excerpt: Retail prices rose 3.93 per cent in May — still below the RBI's 4 per cent target, but accelerating fast. The central bank has already revised its full-year forecast to 5.1 per cent.
news.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai — the central bank faces mounting pressure as retail inflation hits a 2026 high (Wikimedia Commons)
news.nri_angle: Rising food and fuel inflation will hit remittance-dependent families hardest — the rupees NRIs send home are buying less each month, and a weak monsoon could make it worse.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Trump Says Iran Deal Will Be Signed Sunday. The Strait of Hormuz Will Reopen 'Immediately.'
news.excerpt: The announcement sent crude prices tumbling to a two-month low and triggered India's best market day in two months. But Tehran says it has not yet finalised a signing date.
news.image_caption: U.S. Navy ships transit the Strait of Hormuz, the critical oil shipping lane at the centre of the conflict
news.nri_angle: A reopened Hormuz would ease global crude prices, directly lowering fuel and grocery costs for NRIs, while reducing the risk to Indian seafarers who have been caught in the crossfire.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi and Macron Will Inaugurate India's Largest Deep-Tech Showcase in Nice Tomorrow. 120 Startups Made the Cut.
news.excerpt: Bharat Innovates 2026 brings Indian founders in semiconductors, space, biotech and quantum computing to the French Riviera. Twenty-eight MoUs with French and international partners are expected.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi with French President Emmanuel Macron at an earlier bilateral meeting
news.nri_angle: Indian-origin founders and researchers in Europe and the US now have a direct government-backed platform to connect with French capital and research labs — this is the India-France innovation corridor coming alive.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Five Dead After IAF An-32 Crashes at Jorhat. The Fleet Has Killed Over 100 in Four Decades.
news.excerpt: The Soviet-era workhorse broke apart on the runway. Its replacement was promised years ago. It still has not arrived.
news.image_caption: An Indian Air Force Antonov An-32 transport aircraft in flight
news.nri_angle: Two of the five dead were Agnipath recruits — the crash highlights the human cost of India's aging military fleet and the gap between defence modernisation announcements and ground reality.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: King Charles Marks the British Asian Trust's 20th Year With a £1 Million Gala. The Timing Is Not Coincidental.
nri-world.excerpt: The monarch's charity has supported 18.8 million people across South Asia. At a London gala held against the backdrop of anti-Asian unrest, his presence sent a pointed message about community and belonging.
nri-world.image_caption: King Charles III, Royal Founding Patron of the British Asian Trust
nri-world.nri_angle: The King's charity, built around British Asian identity, has supported 18.8 million people in South Asia — and his visible patronage during anti-Asian unrest sends a signal to the 1.9 million Indians in the UK.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India Just Opened Its Stock Markets to Every Foreigner on the Planet. NRIs Are No Longer Special.
nri-world.excerpt: A quiet FEMA amendment published on June 12 replaces the phrase 'NRI or OCI' with 'any individual residing outside India,' dismantling a decades-old investment privilege the diaspora once had to itself.
nri-world.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai's Dalal Street financial district
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs and OCIs who long enjoyed exclusive retail access to Indian equities now share that privilege with every foreign individual — a levelling that could reshape how diaspora investors think about their edge in India's capital markets.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: From the Lincoln Memorial to Times Square: How Yoga Day 2026 Became the Diaspora's Biggest Public Ritual
nri-world.excerpt: The Indian Embassy will host its flagship Yoga Day celebration at the Lincoln Memorial on June 19, while Padma Shri HR Nagendra — Modi's personal yoga guru — headlines the Times Square event on June 21.
nri-world.image_caption: A group practising yoga outdoors in a park setting
nri-world.nri_angle: International Day of Yoga has evolved from a UN calendar date into the Indian diaspora's most visible annual public gathering in the West — a rare moment when thousands of Indian Americans occupy iconic American landmarks to practise something unmistakably Indian.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Dame Parveen Kumar Gets the GBE. She Is Now One of Britain's Most Decorated Indian-Born Citizens.
nri-world.excerpt: The 2026 King's Birthday Honours list, published on June 12, names at least eight British Indians — but the headline belongs to a gastroenterologist from Lahore who spent 40 years in the NHS.
nri-world.image_caption: Dame Parveen Kumar, elevated to GBE in the 2026 Birthday Honours
nri-world.nri_angle: The Birthday Honours remain the most visible annual scoreboard for British Indian professional achievement — and the 2026 list, with a GBE at the top, signals that the community's influence now reaches the highest tiers of the British establishment.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: GIFT City Is No Longer a Policy Experiment. NRI Wealth Managers Are Starting to Notice.
nri-world.excerpt: India's first international financial services centre has approved its inaugural family investment fund, drawn endorsements from Singapore's diplomats, and begun attracting Gulf-based NRI capital fleeing regional instability.
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs managing wealth across multiple jurisdictions now have a credible India-linked alternative to Dubai and Singapore — one that offers tax advantages, lower costs, and direct access to Indian markets without the regulatory friction of onshore investing.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: A Few Dollars in His Pocket, Thirty-Five Years Later: Arvind Raman Now Runs America's Standards Agency
nri-world.excerpt: The Indian-born engineer who arrived at Purdue with almost nothing has been confirmed by the U.S. Senate as director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology — and undersecretary of commerce.
nri-world.image_caption: Neil Armstrong Hall of Engineering at Purdue University, where Arvind Raman served as dean
nri-world.nri_angle: Raman's journey from India to the helm of NIST — the agency that sets America's technology standards — is a distilled version of the Indian immigrant arc: arrive with nothing, build a career through sheer competence, and end up shaping the infrastructure of the country that took you in.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Karnataka's New Chief Minister Has a Plan for 1.8 Million Overseas Kannadigas: Give Them Their Own Department
nri-world.excerpt: Ten days into his tenure, D.K. Shivakumar is reviving a Congress manifesto promise to create a dedicated NRI department — modelled on Kerala's — to channel diaspora investment and address the grievances of Kannadigas abroad.
nri-world.image_caption: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar addressing a public gathering
nri-world.nri_angle: For the estimated 1.8 million Kannadigas scattered across 34 countries, the promise of a dedicated state department means a single window for investment facilitation, property disputes, and welfare support — replacing the current maze of uncoordinated bureaucratic departments.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Nice, Bratislava, Evian, Paris: Modi's Six-Day European Tour Begins and Ends With the Diaspora
nri-world.excerpt: The prime minister's France-Slovakia swing combines G7 diplomacy with startup diplomacy and a community address in Paris — the first by an Indian leader at VivaTech.
nri-world.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who departed for France on June 13 for a six-day European tour
nri-world.nri_angle: Modi will address the Indian community in Paris on June 18 and inaugurate Bharat Innovates in Nice — both directly aimed at diaspora entrepreneurs and professionals in Europe. The visit also raises H-1B visa and trade deal questions that affect every NRI in the US.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India's OCI Cards Have Gone Digital. Here Is What Five Million Holders Need to Know.
nri-world.excerpt: The Citizenship Amendment Rules 2026, notified on April 30, introduce e-OCI registration, mandatory online applications, biometric consent for fast-track immigration, and a ban on dual passports for minors.
nri-world.image_caption: A traveller checks their smartphone at an airport — the kind of scene where the new e-OCI could replace a physical card
nri-world.nri_angle: Every OCI card holder — over 5 million people, mostly in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia — is directly affected. Paper applications are dead. The e-OCI could eliminate the dreaded renewal queue. But mandatory biometric consent and the minor dual-passport ban raise new compliance questions.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Tomorrow, Dartmouth Hands Vivek Murthy an Honorary Doctorate. He Will Probably Talk About Loneliness Again.
nri-world.excerpt: The first Indian-American U.S. Surgeon General, who served under both Obama and Biden, receives an honorary Doctor of Science as the Class of 2026 graduates in Hanover, New Hampshire.
nri-world.image_caption: Dr. Vivek Murthy during his tenure as U.S. Surgeon General
nri-world.nri_angle: Murthy is arguably the most prominent Indian American in US public health history. His parents immigrated from Karnataka, he was raised in Miami, and he has repeatedly credited the Indian concept of Seva — selfless service — as the force behind his work. His loneliness research, his social media youth warnings, and his Parting Prescription for America all grew from a worldview shaped between two cultures.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Twenty-One Years, One Gopuram: Berlin's Sri Ganesha Temple Opens as One of Europe's Largest Hindu Shrines
nri-world.excerpt: Black granite carved in Tamil Nadu, water from the Ganges poured by crane, and a Modi-Merz visit pencilled for October — the Neukölln temple is the diaspora's most ambitious European construction project in a generation.
nri-world.image_caption: The Sri Ganesha Hindu Temple in Berlin's Neukölln district on the day of its consecration, June 7, 2026
nri-world.nri_angle: A two-decade community effort by Berlin's Tamil Hindu diaspora — students, IT workers, Sri Lankan refugees — built one of Europe's largest Hindu temples entirely through donations and volunteer labour, creating a permanent spiritual anchor for South Asians across Germany.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian Banks Are Racing to Offer NRIs Up to 7.1% on Dollar Deposits. The RBI Engineered the Whole Thing.
nri-world.excerpt: A central bank intervention designed to shore up the rupee has turned FCNR deposits into the hottest NRI financial product in a decade, with leverage potentially pushing returns past 20 per cent.
nri-world.image_caption: Indian rupee notes and coins — NRI deposits are now at the centre of a central bank strategy to attract dollars
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs holding dollars in US or Gulf bank accounts now face a rare window — three-to-five-year FCNR deposits in Indian banks offering returns that rival equities, tax-free in India, with principal fully repatriable. The catch: the scheme closes September 30.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Foreign Investors Have Fled 43 of India's 50 Biggest Stocks. Domestic Money Is Filling the Void.
markets-finance.excerpt: FII ownership in Indian equities has plunged to a 14-year low of 14.7 per cent, while domestic institutional holdings have surged to a record 18.9 per cent — a structural shift that reshapes risk and opportunity for NRI investors.
markets-finance.image_caption: Stock market trading screens displaying live price movements
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI investors face a double bind: the record foreign exit from Indian equities has eroded returns in dollar terms, but the structural shift toward domestic ownership may reduce future volatility and create a more favourable entry point.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India’s IT Stocks Have Lost 27 Per Cent This Year. For NRI Tech Workers, the Pain Is Doubly Personal.
markets-finance.excerpt: The Nifty IT index has shed more than a quarter of its value in 2026 as AI disruption fears collide with macro headwinds. For the millions of Indian-origin professionals who work in the same industry they invest in, the exposure is uniquely concentrated.
markets-finance.image_caption: A stock market trading screen displaying real-time financial data and price movements
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI tech workers often hold ESOPs in Indian IT firms, invest in IT-heavy mutual funds, and work in the very sector AI threatens to disrupt — creating a rare triple concentration of career, portfolio, and identity risk.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: GIFT City Just Got Its First US Company Listing. Here Is What NRIs Need to Know.
markets-finance.excerpt: Banking assets at $111 billion, US stocks now accessible, and the first American IPO on Indian exchanges — India's answer to Dubai and Singapore is crossing a threshold.
markets-finance.image_caption: GIFT One tower in Gujarat — the centrepiece of India's first International Financial Services Centre
markets-finance.nri_angle: GIFT City is positioning itself as a tax-efficient hub specifically for NRI wealth management, cross-border investing, and India-linked portfolios — a direct alternative to routing capital through Dubai or Singapore.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India Just Opened Its Stock Market to Every Foreigner on Earth. Here Is What Changed Overnight.
markets-finance.excerpt: A sweeping FEMA amendment notified on June 12 replaces the NRI-only investment framework with one that lets any individual residing outside India buy and sell listed Indian equities — a historic shift in capital account liberalisation.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs already invested in Indian equities now share the playing field with every foreign individual globally — understanding the new rules, limits, and safeguards is essential to protect existing holdings.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Indian Banks Are Offering NRIs Up to 7% on Dollar Deposits. Here Is How to Get the Best Rate Before September.
markets-finance.excerpt: The RBI's unprecedented forex swap has sparked a rate war among banks. Emkay calculates leveraged returns could reach 22%. The window closes September 30.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs can now earn 6-7% on dollar deposits at Indian banks with zero currency risk before the RBI's concessional swap window closes September 30.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India Just Threw Open Its Bond Market to the World. For NRI Investors, the Timing Could Not Be Better.
markets-finance.excerpt: Tax exemptions, subsidised hedging, and a $3 billion corporate debt rush — India's most aggressive capital-market reforms in years are rewriting the playbook for overseas fixed-income investors, with Bloomberg index inclusion now weeks away from a decision.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India building, headquarters of the central bank driving India's bond-market reforms
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI depositors benefit directly from RBI's fully subsidised hedging on foreign currency deposits, while the tax exemptions on government bonds make Indian fixed income a viable portfolio allocation for the first time in years — particularly for diaspora investors burned by the rupee's depreciation and looking for yield with policy support.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: El Nino Is Officially Here. India's Monsoon, Food Prices, and NRI Portfolios Are All in the Firing Line.
markets-finance.excerpt: The US Climate Prediction Center and India's Met department have both confirmed moderate-to-strong El Nino conditions during the monsoon season — the first since 2023 and potentially one of the strongest on record. Here is what it means for your money.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI investors with Indian equity, bond, or commodity exposure face direct portfolio risk from El Nino through FMCG margin compression, rupee weakness, and potential RBI policy shifts.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: BlackRock and Lighthouse Canton Say India Has Been 'Over-Punished.' The Contrarian Case for NRI Investors Is Getting Louder.
markets-finance.excerpt: After a record 30 billion dollars in foreign outflows, the world's largest asset manager and a major wealth firm argue that India's lack of a direct AI play is an advantage — not a liability — and that the worst of the selloff may be over.
markets-finance.image_caption: A stock market trading screen displaying financial data and price movements
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI investors who paused SIPs or sold India positions during the record $30 billion outflow are now hearing from BlackRock and Lighthouse Canton that the selloff has gone too far — a signal that could reshape diaspora portfolio decisions.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Vedanta Splits Into Five: Four Demerged Companies Hit the Stock Market on Monday. Here Is What NRI Investors Need to Know.
markets-finance.excerpt: The largest corporate demerger in Indian history reaches its final act as Vedanta Aluminium, Vedanta Oil & Gas, Vedanta Power, and Vedanta Iron & Steel begin trading on the BSE and NSE on June 15 — creating pure-play bets on India's commodity future.
markets-finance.image_caption: Anil Agarwal, founder and chairman of Vedanta Resources, whose demerger creates four new listed companies on Monday (Wikimedia Commons)
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs holding Vedanta shares through demat or overseas broker accounts will find four new stocks in their portfolios on Monday — understanding the listing mechanics, trade restrictions, and tax implications is essential before the first trade.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: US-Iran Peace Deal Hopes Send Nifty Soaring 2%: What the Oil Shock Reversal Means for Indian Markets and NRI Portfolios
markets-finance.excerpt: A surprise memorandum of understanding between Washington and Tehran triggered the biggest single-day rally in months, with crude prices tumbling and Indian equities surging across sectors

markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI investment portfolios, oil price impact on Indian economy, forex and remittance implications
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India's Gold Tariff Gamble: A 15% Import Duty, a $14 Billion Smuggling Surge, and the NRI Caught in Between
markets-finance.excerpt: New Delhi's bid to curb gold demand and protect forex reserves has revived grey-market channels that could move over 100 tonnes this year.
markets-finance.image_caption: Gold remains culturally central to Indian weddings and festivals, making tariff hikes a deeply personal issue for the diaspora.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRIs who regularly send gold home for weddings and festivals, the tariff hike means higher costs, more scrutiny at customs, and a growing temptation to use grey-market channels — with serious legal consequences.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Nifty Surges Nearly 2% on Iran Peace Hopes as RBI Opens a Dollar Goldmine for NRI Depositors
markets-finance.excerpt: Indian markets posted their best single-day gain in two months as oil prices collapsed on US-Iran deal optimism — and the RBI's subsidised hedging programme is making NRI dollar deposits the most attractive they have been in years
markets-finance.image_caption: A stock market display showing real-time financial data — the Nifty 50 posted its best day in two months on Iran peace hopes
markets-finance.nri_angle: Banks are offering NRIs 6-7% on dollar FCNR deposits with RBI-subsidised hedging — a rare window that closes in September; diaspora investors should evaluate before the deadline.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: He Was Last After Six Rounds. Then Praggnanandhaa Won Four Straight and Made History in Oslo.
sports.excerpt: The 20-year-old from Chennai became the first Indian to win Norway Chess, beating Magnus Carlsen twice in classical play. World champion Gukesh finished last.
sports.image_caption: R Praggnanandhaa at a chess tournament in 2025
sports.nri_angle: Praggnanandhaa’s breakthrough is the latest chapter in India’s chess renaissance — a story that resonates deeply with the diaspora, where chess academies in Indian-American communities have boomed since Anand’s era.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Wants Its Diaspora Athletes Back. The Sports Passport Could Make It Happen.
sports.excerpt: With four Indian-origin footballers at the 2026 World Cup and none wearing blue, the Modi government is exploring a fast-track eligibility pathway for OCI and PIO athletes
sports.image_caption: Sarpreet Singh, the Auckland-born midfielder of Punjabi heritage, in New Zealand's World Cup squad
sports.nri_angle: A proposed Sports Passport could allow OCI and PIO athletes worldwide to represent India, directly impacting diaspora families whose children train in foreign sports systems.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Australia Crushed South Africa by 65 Runs. India's Group A Just Got a Reality Check.
sports.excerpt: Phoebe Litchfield's 23-ball fifty and a four-pronged spin attack dismantled the Proteas in the heaviest defeat in Women's T20 World Cup history — and India were watching
sports.image_caption: Australia's spinners dismantled South Africa for 107 at Old Trafford

food.excerpt: Hindu priests in the holy city are forcing vendors to relabel vegetarian biryani as pulao — but India's 93 million annual biryani orders suggest the dish will outlast the campaign.
food.image_caption: Hyderabadi dum biryani, one of India's most iconic rice dishes

food.title: From Harappa to Your Morning Latte: How Black Sesame Became 2026's Hottest Food Trend
food.excerpt: Grown in the Indus Valley five millennia ago and revered by Ayurvedic healers, the ancient seed is now showing up in Starbucks drinks, protein bowls, and a $17.5 billion global market.
food.image_caption: Black sesame seeds, an ancient superfood now driving one of 2026's biggest food trends

food.title: 12,653 and Counting: Inside the Unstoppable Rise of Indian Restaurants Across America
food.excerpt: From classic New Jersey diners turning into biryani joints to vegan dosa houses in Phoenix, Indian cuisine is reshaping America's dining landscape at a pace not seen before.
food.image_caption: Indian cuisine has become one of America's fastest-growing dining categories, with over 12,600 restaurants nationwide (Wikimedia Commons)

carousel.title: Indian Banks Are Offering NRI Dollar Deposits at Rates Not Seen in a Decade. The RBI Is Picking Up the Tab.
carousel.excerpt: SBI, HDFC, ICICI, and Kotak have all hiked FCNR(B) rates to as high as 7.1 per cent after the central bank agreed to absorb the full hedging cost. Analysts say $60–70 billion could flow in by September.
carousel.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India building in Kolkata
carousel.nri_angle: NRIs can now earn up to 7.1% on dollar deposits in Indian banks — the highest in a decade — with zero currency hedging risk, as the RBI absorbs the cost until September 2026.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Shahid Kapoor Has Two Projects Left. After That, He Has No Idea What He's Doing. That's the Point.
carousel.excerpt: In a revealing interview, the Cocktail 2 star says Bollywood broke its own writers — and he'd rather wait for the right script than fake busy.
carousel.image_caption: Shahid Kapoor at a promotional event (Wikimedia Commons)
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: He Was Last After Six Rounds. Then Praggnanandhaa Won Four Straight and Made History in Oslo.
carousel.excerpt: The 20-year-old from Chennai became the first Indian to win Norway Chess, beating Magnus Carlsen twice in classical play. World champion Gukesh finished last.
carousel.image_caption: R Praggnanandhaa at a chess tournament in 2025
carousel.nri_angle: Praggnanandhaa’s breakthrough is the latest chapter in India’s chess renaissance — a story that resonates deeply with the diaspora, where chess academies in Indian-American communities have boomed since Anand’s era.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: SpaceX's Record $75 Billion IPO Lands at $1.75 Trillion. India Just Froze Starlink.
carousel.excerpt: Indian retail investors are rushing to buy on platforms like Vested and Borderless, even as New Delhi blocks Starlink's commercial launch over security concerns tied to the Iran conflict.
carousel.image_caption: A rocket launches from a spaceport against a dark cloudy sky
carousel.nri_angle: Indian retail investors are pouring money into SpaceX through LRS-enabled platforms, but Starlink's India freeze raises questions about connectivity for NRI families and sovereign tech control.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Foreign Investors Have Fled 43 of India's 50 Biggest Stocks. Domestic Money Is Filling the Void.
carousel.excerpt: FII ownership in Indian equities has plunged to a 14-year low of 14.7 per cent, while domestic institutional holdings have surged to a record 18.9 per cent — a structural shift that reshapes risk and opportunity for NRI investors.
carousel.image_caption: Stock market trading screens displaying live price movements
carousel.nri_angle: NRI investors face a double bind: the record foreign exit from Indian equities has eroded returns in dollar terms, but the structural shift toward domestic ownership may reduce future volatility and create a more favourable entry point.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
